name: Ferrolin
description: Ferrolin is a comprehensive metabolic supplement designed for the altered nutritional requirements of heavily augmented physiology, where synthetic organs, chrome-adjacent tissue, and SNT networks create dramatically different demands for trace metals, enzymatic cofactors, and bioelectric precursors than a fully organic body. It is the only major medical product produced by Nightshade Pharmatech that is fully legal — a calculated legitimacy anchor for the company's otherwise gray-market portfolio.
effects: correction of augmentation-associated trace metal deficiencies
support of altered metabolic pathways in hybrid physiology
bioelectric precursor supplementation for SNT network maintenance
prevention of the fatigue and cognitive decline associated with augmented nutritional deficit
enzymatic cofactor support for synthetic organ systems
side_effects: dark discoloration of urine and stool from iron and metallic compound excretion
can interact with some augment rejection suppressors — requires timing management
in purely organic individuals, causes significant digestive distress
long-term use without augmentation can cause trace metal accumulation
cultural_context: Ferrolin is the most visible legitimate product in Nightshade Pharmatech's catalog, and the company knows it — Ferrolin is priced accessibly and marketed hard to establish Nightshade as a trustworthy brand. This legitimacy is deliberately cultivated to provide cover for their gray-market operations. On the street, people are generally aware that Nightshade is sketchy, but Ferrolin works and is affordable, so most augmented people in the Gray Zone take it without much thought. Health professionals in Tier 3+ quietly note that Nightshade's transparency about Ferrolin's formulation is conspicuously complete compared to their other products.
story_hooks: Nightshade has quietly altered Ferrolin's formula to include a long-half-life tracer compound that accumulates in SNT tissue — someone is building a map of every heavily augmented person in GLMZ through their Ferrolin purchases.

A Tier 1 community that relies on Ferrolin is experiencing a mysterious cluster of neurological symptoms — the batch they received has an unidentified compound that wasn't there before, and Nightshade's response to inquiries has been unusually aggressive.

A Nightshade Pharmatech insider wants to expose the company's use of Ferrolin as a legitimacy shield — they have documents proving the legal drug line exists entirely to protect the gray-market operation — but they need someone to get the information out safely.
